## History

Phillips served as the schoolmaster in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), having secured his teaching position because his uncle was a school trustee, and he boarded at the house of Eben Wright. During his time teaching, he disciplined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for smashing her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head, made her stand at the blackboard, and later forced her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for arriving late. Following these events, Phillips eventually departed from his role as the local schoolmaster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as a mentor to [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) during his time teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their academic relationship continues through his eventual departure from the school at the end of the term. His guidance forms a central part of Prissy's education during this period.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027)</sub>
